description: SALTED CARAMEL COOKIES - save this recipe✨  185g brown butter 215g light brown sugar 1 egg + 1 yolk 1 tsp vanilla  225g plain flour 3/4 tsp bicarb 1 tsp salt 120g milk chocolate 120g dark chocolate 150g chewy caramels   - Brown the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat (I’ve got a reel all about how to get perfect brown butter!). Add this to a mixing bowl along with the light brown sugar and mix. Add the egg & extra yolk, vanilla and whisk to combine. Add all the dry ingredients and fold through the chocolate chips & chewy caramels - keep a few back to push into the tops of each cookie.  - Weigh out 60g balls and place on a lined baking tray - put this into the fridge for at least 2 hours (or overnight) to firm up and chill.   - Space the chilled cookie balls about 2 inches apart on a lined baking tray and bake at 170°C (fan) for 10 minutes.   - Generously sprinkle the cookies with sea salt when they’re just out of the oven and enjoy!  ✨TOP TIPS✨  - Chill the cookie dough for 24 hours+, it makes a huge difference to flavour & texture  - Use a heavy duty baking sheet - they distribute the heat a lot more evenly than flimsy trays so your cookies won’t burn on the bottom before they’re baked to perfection.  - Grab a cookie cutter bigger than your cookies and scoot around the edge for perfectly round treats!   #baking #baked #thebakefeed #foodstyling #foodphotography #foodtographyschool #foodtography #lightroom #lumixgh5 #iphone13promax #iphone13 #cookies #cookie #saltysweet #saltedcaramel #caramel
